question: Mubvunzo
defaultDirections: Sarudza mhinduro yaunofunga kuti inopindura mubvunzo. Kana wapedza, dzvanya {checkAnswer}. Uchawana mhinduro inoratidza kana mhinduro yako yakarurama uye zvekuita zvinotevera.
relatedContentDescription: Izvi zvinogadzira nzvimbo yakapetwa yezvinoenderana nemubvunzo uyu uye zvinogara zvichiratidzwa
hintDescription: Izvi zvinoratidzwa kana mushandisi akakanganisa mhinduro
evidenceDescription: Izvi zvinoratidzwa kana mushandisi akarurama mhinduro
dropzoneDirections: Sarudza zita kuti urinhonge, wobva wasarudza nzvimbo yemufananidzo yarinoenderana nayo. Sarudza zita rakaiswa kuti uridzose. Mamwe mazita anogona kunge akawedzerwa. Kana nzvimbo yese ine zita, dzvanya {checkAnswer}.
keyboardDirections: Nekeyboard: Enter kana Space zvinonhonga zita, Tab inofamba pakati penzvimbo, Enter inoisa zita uye Escape inoridzosa.
